messages:
maria: Hey team — customer in prod upgraded to @redwood/js-sdk@0.24.0 and immediately started seeing 404 on /v1/chat.create, then huge bursts of 401s from retries. Rolling back to 0.23 fixed it. Billing alert triggered. Can someone triage? :thinking_face:

kevin: Which region/host and sample request? Any stack traces? :eyes:

maria: region=us-west1 (hosted). Minimal snippet: ```js
import { Redwood } from '@redwood/js-sdk';
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY });
await client.chat.create({ model: 'redwood-7b', input: 'hi' });
``` Errors: first request -> 404 for /v1/chat.create, then retry attempts return 401. Curl against same API with header returns 200.

alex: Quick check: run `node -p 'require("@redwood/js-sdk/package.json").version'` and `npm ls @redwood/js-sdk`. 0.24 changed some constructor fields in the client in the last release candidate — could be auth middleware rename.

maria: npm ls -> @redwood/js-sdk@0.24.0. We verified RW_KEY env is set. Manual curl works: ```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $RW_KEY" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat.create -d '{"input":"x"}'
``` returns 200. Logs show first attempt includes Authorization, subsequent retry lacks Authorization and gets 401.

sasha: Can you paste the runtime request headers and the SDK error? Also are requests going through a proxy (could strip headers on redirect)? :thinking_face:

maria: From app logs: first req headers: `Authorization: Bearer XXX`, user-agent, content-type. Retry attempt headers: Authorization missing. SDK stack: `RequestError: 401 Unauthorized` at `fetchRetry (/path/node_modules/@redwood/js-sdk/lib/fetch.js:88:15)` request id: rq_1234abcd. We saw ~2k retries over ~3m, triggered billing spike.

kevin: That smells like a retry middleware regression where auth is stored in per-request config and not copied onto the retried request. @eng-oncall can you take eyes on the fetch/retry impl? Tagging eng-runtime. :wave:

eng-oncall: Looking now. Can you share full stack trace and the SDK debug log (set `DEBUG=redwood:*`)? I will try to repro locally with 0.24 and the repro snippet.

maria: Stack trace + request id pasted above. I created a small repro gist: https://gist.github.com/maria/abc123 — steps: `git clone && npm i @redwood/js-sdk@0.24 && RW_KEY=xxx node repro.js` -> observe 404 then 401s. Reverting to 0.23 reproduces normal behavior.

alex: Short-term mitigation: advise customer to pin @redwood/js-sdk@0.23.6 and redeploy. I'll open an internal PR for 0.24.1 to ensure headers are preserved across retries. Also adding an integration test for auth through retry.

kevin: Also verify SDK didn't rename request shape (e.g., `sessionToken` -> `session`) which could explain some 404s if the route expects a different body. But since curl to same route works and first request is 404, then 401 on retry, this is more likely header loss rather than body rename.

maria: Confirmed body payloads look identical between versions in our logs. This is header loss. Customer has been rolled back and notified. They asked for ETA on a patch.

support-bot: Created ticket SUP-2026-1123 and linked to engineering issue RWD-894. Notified customer with rollback instructions and gave temporary refund for the burst billing. :white_check_mark:

kevin: Thanks. Eng-runtime will prioritize a hotfix. Can you share the exact request id (rq_1234abcd) with the infra logs? We'll correlate with API gateway to check if any gateway-level header changes happened during retries.

maria: Will share request id and full logs in the ticket. For now customer pinned to 0.23.6. Appreciate the fast triage.

alex: Plan: create 0.24.1 to preserve Authorization across retry + tests, cut patch today, and coordinate release notes. I'll post PR link here.

sasha: Assigning follow-up and marking as priority P1 until patch lands. :red_circle:

maria: Ack — I'll update customer when patch is out. Thanks everyone.
